headline: Trading cards, circus skills and neighbourhood discoveries
summary: Weekend finds include Canopi’s trading and retro-game day, Goodsheds play and Penylan LEGO. Weekday sessions include youth softball and circus skills; exact ages and costs are shown on each card.

datedPicks.ageSuitability: Organiser: preschool children; children aged 3–4 need a paid child ticket.
datedPicks.parentTip: Book admission and the included Mini Wildlings session ahead. Star Stories costs an extra £2 per child.

datedPicks.title: Circus skills & butter-making at the Food Festival
datedPicks.location: St Fagans National Museum of History, Cardiff CF5 6XB
datedPicks.cost: Free entry · parking £7 · some activities paid
datedPicks.description: Try circus skills, watch traditional butter-making and follow the family trail between food stalls. These activities are part of the annual St Fagans Food Festival.
datedPicks.appeal: Give them something to try and discover while you explore the food stalls.
datedPicks.ageSuitability: Organiser welcomes families. DoNext fit: ages 5–12 for the hands-on activities, with younger siblings along.
datedPicks.parentTip: Butter-making ends at 15:00. Circus workshops run 10:00–12:30, 13:30–16:00 and 16:30–18:00; check any activity charge in the programme.

datedPicks.title: Cardiff Brick Festival
datedPicks.location: National Indoor Athletics Centre, Cyncoed Campus, 9 Cyncoed Rd, Cardiff CF23 6XD
datedPicks.cost: Adult £8 · age 5–12 £6 · organiser advertises family £20 and early entry £13; check final booking total.
datedPicks.description: Build at the communal tables, see large LEGO displays and sign up for a timed building challenge. There are also traders selling bricks and sets.
datedPicks.appeal: For a child who wants to build as well as look at impressive models.
datedPicks.ageSuitability: DoNext fit: LEGO fans aged 5–12. Under-5s can enter free with a paying adult.
datedPicks.parentTip: Standard entry starts at 11:00; early entry starts at 10:00. Booking listings have shown different family and early-entry totals; confirm the current price before paying.

datedPicks.title: Wild West play party at Goodsheds
datedPicks.cost: £18.70 for one child + one adult on booking page · extra adults £2 advertised
datedPicks.ageSuitability: DoNext fit: preschool and early primary. Organiser welcomes all ages; an adult must stay.
datedPicks.description: Songs, dancing, bubbles and parachute play, finishing with cowboy-boot decorating and a character photo opportunity.
datedPicks.appeal: A lively morning for younger children who enjoy pretending, moving and making.
datedPicks.parentTip: Book ahead. Allow £18.70 for the child-and-adult ticket, above the £17 advertised headline.

datedPicks.title: Free LEGO hour at Penylan Library
datedPicks.location: Penylan Library and Community Centre, Penylan Road, Cardiff CF23 5HW
datedPicks.ageSuitability: Ages 2+ (organiser). DoNext fit: best for younger builders with an adult.
datedPicks.description: An hour to build something of your own at the local library’s weekly LEGO club.
datedPicks.appeal: A simple free building session when a big ticketed day feels like too much.
datedPicks.parentTip: The library lists this weekly. Confirm it’s running before making a special trip.

datedPicks.title: Trading cards & retro games at Canopi
datedPicks.location: The Canopi, 59–61 Tudor Street, Cardiff CF11 6AD
datedPicks.cost: Free entry · buying cards is optional
datedPicks.ageSuitability: DoNext fit: card and gaming fans aged 8–12 with an adult; no organiser age limit stated.
datedPicks.description: A local collectors’ afternoon with a trading room, space for trading-card games and vintage consoles. Free entry makes it easy to have a look before committing to anything.
datedPicks.appeal: Take your card-game fan somewhere they can meet other enthusiasts and explore older consoles.
datedPicks.parentTip: Stay with your child and agree a swap or spending limit before they bring their cards.
datedPicks.bookingStatus: free entry · no booking link listed
